caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, long-sleeved dress with a wide, bell-shaped skirt and fitted bodice, rendered in a reddish-brown color with an overlay of intricate black lace or embroidery in floral and geometric patterns. The dress features a high neckline with a white lace collar and white undersleeves or cuffs that extend slightly beyond the ends of the sleeves. The waistline is cinched, and the skirt flares outward to the floor. To the right of the main dress illustration, there is a secondary, smaller, and less detailed line drawing of the same dress, showing the back view with the same wide skirt and fitted bodice. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Dress
